mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inv_stock WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 AND qty > 0 ORDER BY last_in_date

SELECT s.id AS stock_id, s.warehouse_id, s.warehouse_name, s.product_id, s.product_code, s.product_name, s.qty, s.available_qty, s.avg_cost, s.total_cost, s.create_time, w.warehouse_name AS wh_name, p.safety_stock AS p_safety_stock FROM inv_stock s LEFT JOIN base_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN base_product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.qty > 0 AND p.safety_stock IS NOT NULL AND p.safety_stock > 0 AND s.qty < p.safety_stock ORDER BY s.qty ASC, s.product_id, s.warehouse_id
